gist.headline: One more bee in the hive
gist.blurb: ZapGaming has been added to the GitHub identity list. The garden gate recognizes another familiar face.
gist.summary: Added ZapGaming to the shared GitHub ID allowlist used by the project’s authentication tooling.
gist.impact: Project authentication can now recognize ZapGaming’s GitHub identity wherever this shared allowlist is used.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden-gate welcome scene representing a newly recognized community contributor: Polli checks a tiny GitHub-style identity card against a glowing allowlist ledger while code-vines and flowers grow around the gate.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute pixel bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blush, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings, wearing a tiny gatekeeper cap as she warmly stamps a little GitHub identity card beside a glowing lime green (#ecf874) garden gate and a retro terminal allowlist ledger; code-plants, flowers, and soft vines bloom around her. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, with subtle pixel-font text: "WELCOME, ZAPGAMING".
